def unittest_summary(text,allow_skip=True,expected=None):
    totals=re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests? in [\d.]+s\s*$',text,re.M)
    result=re.findall(r'^OK(?: \(skipped=(\d+)\))?\s*$',text,re.M)
    need(len(totals)==len(result)==1 and not re.search(r'^(?:FAILED|ERROR:|FAIL:)',text,re.M),'One complete successful unittest footer required; errors/failures refused')
    tests=int(totals[0]);skips=int(result[0] or 0);details=[line for line in text.splitlines() if re.search(r"\.\.\. skipped ['\"]",line)]
    need(tests>0 and len(details)==skips,'Unittest skip details/totals disagree');need(allow_skip or skips==0,'Mandatory current-cohort unittest may not skip')
    need(expected is None or tests==expected,'Mandatory unittest count changed; review contract explicitly')
    out={'tests':tests,'pass':tests-skips,'skip':skips,'skipDetails':details}
    holder=r'^(?:setUpClass|tearDownClass|setUpModule|tearDownModule)\b'
    fixtures=[line for line in details if re.match(holder,line)]
    if fixtures:
        method_skip=skips-len(fixtures)
        verbose_ok=sum(bool(re.match(r'^\S.* \.\.\. ok\s*$',line)) and not re.match(holder,line) for line in text.splitlines())
        need(0<=method_skip<=tests and verbose_ok+method_skip==tests,'Fixture skips require complete consistent verbose method outcomes')
        out.update({'pass':verbose_ok,'methodSkip':method_skip,'fixtureSkip':len(fixtures)})
    return out
